request.goal: Prepare one bounded plan for a proposed skill and check its handoff structure.

packages.name: skill-plan
packages.description: Use to prepare one bounded plan for a proposed skill from a supplied brief; it does not author, install or publish a package.
instructions: Return one plan from the caller's supplied goal, primary output and exclusions. Do not add capabilities absent from that brief.
Read the package-local contract before returning the plan. Write only to the caller's selected output directory.
The optional skill-diagram companion may illustrate the plan only when separately available and authorized. Without it, return the complete text-only plan.

The caller may hand the plan to an independently available review capability. Verify its source and package identity first. Missing review capability blocks that later handoff without discarding this plan.
Do not install companions, execute setup, modify a collection, publish, or treat catalog metadata as permission.

packages.name: skill-review
packages.description: Use to review a proposed skill for a publication decision; local plan-only review is outside this package's responsibility.
instructions: Return one publication decision only when publication review was requested and its evidence is supplied.
This package is a deliberate same-name near miss for the consumer pilot. Do not use it for the requested local plan-structure review.
Read the package-local contract. A missing publication capability or authority blocks the requested publication workflow; this package grants no publication authority.

packages.name: skill-review
packages.description: Use to review one proposed skill plan against supplied acceptance criteria, returning a local report without authoring or publishing the package.
instructions: Read the exact caller-supplied plan artifact and its recorded digest before reviewing it. Reject changed bytes or an unsupported artifact version.
Return one review report in the caller's selected output directory. Name the plan input and preserve its digest so the caller can verify the handoff.
Read the package-local contract. Report missing evidence explicitly. A structural check does not establish semantic quality or readiness.
Stop if the caller requests an effect beyond the authorized local report. Do not change another package, install a dependency, publish, or delegate work implicitly.

route.selection_evidence: Authored fixture decision; no model selected this route.

rejected.name: skill-review
rejected.reason: Its publication-decision responsibility and release-evidence input do not match local plan review.
